headline: New construction at 43 St. Lawrence Street approved 5-0 on a vacant lot in the Munjoy Hill Historic District.
summary: The applicant is 43 St. Lawrence Street Development LLC. The project architect said the revised design sets the roof railing back about 4'6 from the roof edge, adds a projecting bay on Gilbert Lane, and adds a fence between the properties. Members said the changes help reduce the building's visual mass. The meeting also elected a temporary vice chair for the evening.
decisions: Approved new construction at 43 St. Lawrence Street, 5-0.
Elected a temporary vice chair for the evening, 5-0.
discussion: Mass and scale: Members said new buildings on the hill are growing in mass and scale, which runs counter to the neighborhood's green space, though zoning permits the height and lot coverage.
Design changes: Members said the revisions, including the set-back roof railing and the Gilbert Lane bay, helped the design and the building's visual mass.
Draft findings: Staff proposed that all the standards seem to have been met, and members agreed the design is consistent with the draft findings.

decision_evidence.quote: I move to approve application HP 00892026 for new construction at 43 St. Lawrence Street on the basis of submitted documentation, plans, and specifications, information provided in the staff memo, and the attached findings by the historic preservation board as written that the project meets subsection 16.6.4 standards for review of additions and new construction. ... Motion carries.
Okay, roll call. Yes, Madam Chair Pro Tem, Hillary Bassett, Cesar Cardi. Yes. Michael Hutchins. Yes. Rob Witten. Yes. Valerie Pinkle. Yes. The election is carried.

decision_titles: New construction at 43 St. Lawrence Street
